_comment: Leave-one-position-out: does scale(position) reach a position the intervention never trained on? Onion and spiral, source-modified. Each non-empty heldout_positions entry trains without edits at that position (train and val) and scores it on the full test set; [] is the same config trained on every position, the in-distribution reference -- and the same run as table 2's source-modified onion/spiral cells. Positions 0-8 are the ones the WFE test set edits. 2 models x 10 x 4 seeds = 80 runs. Expanded and executed by `python -m intervention.generalization`.
